# The composition roots of the built-in modules (docs/architecture/core-and-modules.md "Guards"): the packages that may
# import internal/modules/all, the one list of built-in modules, so the manager they run loads them. Nothing else
# outside internal/modules imports a module (TestCoreImportsNoModule).
internal/manager
internal/managercli
# The binaries that run the built-in modules' extension programs as subcommands (`personad volc`, internal/builtinext).
cmd/personad
cmd/persona-manager
# The node's composition root (`personad node`, persona-node and the manager's local node): imports
# internal/modules/all/node, the modules that also run on the user's computers (the iMessage reader of a Mac).
internal/nodecmd
